description: Put a person on the clinic's waiting list for one option when no free time suits: dates, parts of the day and a practitioner if wanted. A code goes to their phone, then confirm_with_code. The clinic sends an SMS when a time frees up; nothing is held.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

name.description: The person's full name, as they say it.

note.description: A short note to the clinic in the person's words. Never health details.

parts_of_day.description: morning (07-12), afternoon (12-17) or evening (17-22); omit for any time.

phone.description: The person's mobile number. The code goes there by SMS.

to_date.description: Last wanted day (YYYY-MM-DD); default two weeks on.

name: join_waitlist

code_sent_to.description: The masked phone or email the code went to.

confirmation_id.description: Pass it to confirm_with_code with the code.

status.description: code_sent: ask the person for the code, then call confirm_with_code.

title: Join the waiting list
